Page.Games: Your favorites and recently played experiences.
Page.Servers: Browse an experience's public servers and join a specific one.
Page.Appearance: Every change applies instantly and is saved automatically.
Page.LoadingScreen: What you see while Roblox starts. It closes by itself when Roblox opens.
Page.Performance: Frame rate and graphics. These settings change limits and quality; they can't make your PC faster.
Page.FastFlags: Roblox client configuration flags, with honest notes on what still works.
Page.RobloxSettings: Roblox's own settings, plus how Nexstrap launches it.
Page.Integrations: Connect Nexstrap with the rest of your setup.
Page.Notifications: Updates and setup problems worth a look.
Language.Description: Setup, the menu and page titles are translated. The rest of the app is in English for now.
Setup.Title: Nexstrap Setup
Setup.Welcome.Heading: Welcome to Nexstrap
Setup.Welcome.Text: This installs Nexstrap {0} for your Windows account. You don't need admin rights.
Setup.Update.Heading: Update Nexstrap
Setup.Update.Text: Nexstrap is already installed. This replaces it with version {0}. Your settings stay as they are.
Setup.Options.Heading: Choose your options
Setup.Links.Hint: Play buttons on the Roblox website will start through Nexstrap. Uninstalling puts your previous launcher back.
Setup.Done.Heading: Nexstrap is installed
Setup.Done.Text: You can remove it any time from Installed apps in Windows Settings.
Setup.Error.Folder: Choose a folder on this PC that you can write to. The suggested folder always works.
Setup.Error.AdminFolder: This folder needs admin rights. Choose one in your user folder, like the suggested one.
Uninstall.Title: Uninstall Nexstrap?
Uninstall.Text: This removes Nexstrap and its shortcuts, and gives Roblox links back to your previous launcher.
Uninstall.Data.Title: Delete your Nexstrap data too?
Uninstall.Data.Text: This includes your settings, themes and the Roblox build Nexstrap installed. If you keep them, they'll be there if you reinstall.
Uninstall.Running.Title: Close Nexstrap first
Uninstall.Running.Text: Nexstrap is still open. Close it, then try again.
Uninstall.NotInstalled.Title: Nothing to uninstall
Uninstall.NotInstalled.Text: This copy of Nexstrap isn't installed, so you can simply delete the file.
Uninstall.Done.Title: Nexstrap was removed
Uninstall.Failed.Title: Nexstrap couldn't be fully removed
